WebPortfolio.heroDescription: A Full-Stack Developer with a passion for creating and innovative.
WebPortfolio.aboutParagraph1: Hi, im Ethan Grané, a Fullstack Developer based in Barcelona currently focused on React and Next.js. Im passionate about building clean, thoughtfully designed web interfaces.
WebPortfolio.aboutParagraph2: I have been passionate about programming since I was a child. I consider it both my hobby and my profession in equal measure. I am always looking for opportunities to learn, grow, and contribute to more complex and challenging projects.
WebPortfolio.aboutParagraph3: Ive also been making games in Unity as a personal hobby since I was 16, which gave me a solid foundation in logic, performance, and problem-solving.

socialNetwork.title: Social Network with VUE & Laravel
socialNetwork.description: A location-based social network where users can create posts tied to any point on the map, combining social interaction with geolocation to provide a unique way of discovering content.

steamMarketAnalyzer.title: Steam Market Analyzer
steamMarketAnalyzer.description: Steam Market Analyzer is a mobile application developed with React Native that allows developers, analysts, and enthusiasts in the video game industry to study the Steam market quickly and intuitively.

digitalLogicSimulator.title: Digital Logic Simulator
digitalLogicSimulator.description: In this project I made a logic gate simulator where you can create your own logic gates and combine them infinitely; the maximum calculation capacity I have tested has been a basic binary calculator. With this project I got an excellent grade in advanced programming

gattosPizzeria.title: Gatto's Pizzeria
gattosPizzeria.description: In this first-person cozy cooking game, you can choose between 5 adorable cats and manage a small pizzeria full of hungry human customers.

factorioClicker.title: Factorio Clicker
factorioClicker.description: A first-person game that blends Factorio and CookieClicker. In this prototype, your goal is to automate the collection and sale of resources to improve your buildings and abilities.

deterministicFactoryGame.title: Deterministic Factory Game
deterministicFactoryGame.description: A 2D top-down game where you must defend yourself against enemies in a tower defense style by building defenses similar to Factorio. Modify the enemy's path to give yourself more time to defeat them before they reach your base.

raytracedSpatialAudio.title: Raytraced Spatial Audio
raytracedSpatialAudio.description: A spatial audio system that uses raytracing to drive dynamic acoustics and occlusion, so sound reacts to the real geometry of your scene.

digAHoleKit.title: Dig a Hole Kit
digAHoleKit.description: A 3D digging engine built on Jobs and Burst, letting players dig into terrain in real time with great performance.

reflectIt.title: Reflect It!
reflectIt.description: A URP glass and refraction shader pack with both stylized and realistic looks, ready to drop into your project.

infestIt.title: Infest It
infestIt.description: A smart insect emitter for Unity that fills your scenes with living swarms of insects.

soundIt.title: Sound It
soundIt.description: Sound It: Adaptive Audio Source is a lightweight and intuitive Unity tool for creating dynamic, shape-based audio sources. Easily define audio using meshes, paths, or polygons.

splineAudioSource.title: Spline Audio Source
splineAudioSource.description: A free Unity tool that lets you shape audio sources along splines.

stylizedHandpaintedPack.title: Stylized Handpainted Shader & Textures Pack
stylizedHandpaintedPack.description: A stylized handpainted shader and texture pack for URP with triplanar mapping and PBR support.
